mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 1

, all_role_codes AS ( SELECT DISTINCT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE r.status = 1) SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_codes arc ON rp.role_code = arc.role_code JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE p.status = 1
